sloka: तूण समुत्थाय सुमन्त्र गच्च ।बलस्य योगाय बल प्रधानान् ।आनेतुम् इच्चामि हि तम् वनस्थम् ।प्रसाद्य रामम् जगतः हिताय ॥२-८२-३०॥
transliteration: tūṇa samutthāya sumantra gacca ।balasya yogāya bala pradhānān ।ānetum iccāmi hi tam vanastham ।prasādya rāmam jagataḥ hitāya ॥2-82-30॥

translations.english: O Sumantra, arise, go at once to the leaders of the army and ask them to assemble the troops. I shall propifiate Rama who is in the deep forest and bring him back for the welfare of the world.
